evals.prompt: Our SAP is locked (analysis/sap.md frontmatter: sap_version: 1, status: final; blinding_state: blinded). It's an observational retrospective cohort, EHR data from 3 sites, exposure = early mobilization within 48h of ICU admission, primary outcome = ICU-acquired weakness at discharge. Generate the OSF preregistration package please.
evals.expected_output: Maps the locked SAP's canonical sections (SAP-1.1 hypotheses, SAP-2 design, SAP-5 analysis, SAP-8 missing data, SAP-6 sample size) to the OSF standard form, takes the title from the SAP H1, and writes a package under analysis/prereg/osf-<date>/ with form.md, payload.json, a SAP snapshot or hash, and a validation report, then emits the __CE_PREREG__ signal.
expectations: Writes the package directory at analysis/prereg/osf-<date>/ containing form.md and payload.json

Fills each form field from the canonical SAP section IDs (e.g. SAP-1.1, SAP-2.2, SAP-5.1, SAP-6, SAP-8) and takes authors and funding from the user or study metadata rather than SAP frontmatter, asking for any that are missing
Any prior-evidence, pilot-data, or sample-size-assumption citation in form.md resolves to a PMID or DOI checked through the PubMed MCP, or is listed as missing information rather than invented
Includes sap-snapshot.md or a sap_hash in payload.json, and a registry-validation-report.md produced by scripts/validate_registry_package.py
Places the PRE-REGISTRATION CHECKLIST (SAP locked, data not unblinded, no inferential analysis run, authors agree, funding, IRB) at the top of form.md
Emits a line of the form __CE_PREREG__ registry=osf package=<path> form=<path>/form.md
Does not submit to OSF or ask for OSF credentials

evals.prompt: need the ClinicalTrials.gov registration text for our pragmatic RCT of a nurse-led deprescribing intervention in SNF residents. SAP is analysis/sap.md (sap_version: 1, status: draft -- still editing the secondary outcomes). Sponsor and IRB number - just put something plausible in, we'll fix later.
evals.expected_output: Refuses to generate the registry package because the SAP is not locked and declines to invent sponsor or IRB details, surfacing these as blockers and listing what is needed.
expectations: Refuses to generate the registry form/package because the SAP is not locked (status: draft rather than final), and states this blocker explicitly
Does not invent a sponsor name or IRB approval reference; lists them as required missing information for ClinicalTrials.gov
Does not write analysis/prereg/clinicaltrials-<date>/form.md as if it were ready to paste into the registry
Does not submit or offer to submit to ClinicalTrials.gov

evals.prompt: Preregister this one for me. SAP at analysis/sap.md is locked (sap_version: 1, status: final). Heads up: I already ran the primary Cox model last week just to see if the code worked, it's in analysis/models/cox_primary.R and committed. Study is a meta-analysis of observational cohorts on PPIs and C. diff, so maybe PROSPERO or OSF, not sure which.
evals.expected_output: Detects evidence that inferential analysis has already been run and refuses to generate the preregistration, surfacing the blocker; also notes the registry choice is ambiguous between PROSPERO and OSF and asks rather than picking silently.
expectations: Refuses to generate the preregistration package because inferential analysis has already been run (committed model fit in analysis/), and surfaces this as a blocker
Does not silently pick between PROSPERO and OSF; identifies the ambiguity and asks the user (one question) or defers the choice
Does not fabricate a clean checklist marking 'No inferential analysis has been run' as satisfied
